transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I came in because I’ve been really struggling since I tried to make my art into an actual freelance business. I get so wound up about invoices and client messages that I end up avoiding them, and then it sort of piles up until I’m crying at my kitchen table. I’m even forgetting normal things, like paying a bill.
Do you find yourself feeling anxious or worried about other things in your life, even when there isn’t a specific problem or deadline? Like, do you worry about things in general a lot of the time?

I don’t think so, not in that general way. It feels more tied to specific things, like when there’s something I need to deal with. I’m not usually sitting around worrying about everything for no reason.
When you’re feeling overwhelmed by work or client responsibilities, do you notice any physical symptoms like a racing heart, sweating, or stomach issues?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed anything major like sweating or stomach problems. I might feel tense when I’m overwhelmed, but I don’t really track physical symptoms that much.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you used to enjoy, even when it’s not related to work or client issues?

I’m not really sure. I wouldn’t say I feel hopeless all the time or anything. I still like the things I usually like, but when the work stuff piles up, it can kind of spill over and make everything feel heavier. Outside of that, I haven’t really noticed it as a separate thing.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about specific problems, like work or responsibilities, even when you're not actively dealing with them?

Yes. It’s mostly specific stuff, like invoices or client messages. Since I started trying to make my art into an actual freelance business, I get really wound up about those things even when I’m not doing them. Then I put them off, and it builds up until I’m crying at the kitchen table or realizing I forgot something normal, like paying a bill.
Outside of the work-related stress, have you noticed any days where you feel down or sad for no clear reason, and if so, how often does that happen?
I haven’t really noticed that happening much. If I feel down, it usually seems tied to the stress or feeling behind on things. I don’t think I have many days where I’m just sad for no clear reason.
Outside of work and client responsibilities, do you find yourself worrying a lot about other everyday things, like relationships, health, or other obligations?
Not really, no. I mean, normal things come up, but I don’t think I worry a lot about relationships or health or things like that. It mostly seems to center on the work and client stuff.
Do you feel especially anxious or self-conscious when you’re in situations where others might be watching you or judging your work, like when presenting your art or talking to clients?

I’m not sure it’s about being watched or judged, exactly. I can feel nervous talking to clients, but it feels more like pressure to handle things right than fear of people looking at me. I haven’t really noticed a big anxiety around presenting my art specifically.
Do you find that the anxiety or pressure around work responsibilities affects your ability to focus or function in other parts of your life, like personal time or hobbies?

Yes, a bit. It’s started spilling over into other things. Like I put off replying to a client because I felt overwhelmed, and I missed a utility payment while I was trying to keep up with the art display. So it’s not constant, but it is affecting my responsibilities.
Do you often feel anxious or on edge about things related to your freelance work even when there’s no immediate deadline or specific task due, like during your downtime or weekends?

Yes. Even when there isn’t something due right that second, I’ll still get wound up thinking about invoices or client messages. Then I put them off, and it kind of builds until I’m really upset, like crying at my kitchen table. It’s also making me forget normal things, like paying a bill.
Have you noticed any days where you feel down or lose interest in your art or other activities, even when things with clients or invoices aren’t piling up?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed clear days like that where I’m just down or not interested for no reason. It seems more tied to when the work stuff starts feeling like too much.
Have you noticed yourself worrying about more than one area of your life — like relationships, health, or other responsibilities — and not just work, even if it’s not all the time?

I’m not sure I’d say it spreads into a lot of areas. I mean, sometimes I worry about regular responsibilities, but it mostly seems connected to the work stuff or things I’ve let pile up because of it. I haven’t really noticed it being about my health or relationships much.
Do you find that your anxiety about work responsibilities, like invoices or client messages, is constant or nearly constant, even when there's no clear reason to be anxious at that moment?

It’s not constant every minute, no. It’s more like since I tried to make my art into actual freelance work, I get wound up over things like invoices or client messages, and then I avoid them. Then it builds up until I’m really upset, like crying at my kitchen table, or I start forgetting normal stuff like paying a bill.
Do you find that your anxiety or worry about work responsibilities, like invoices or client messages, happens on more days than not, even if it's not always severe?

Yeah, I think it does happen more days than not lately. It’s not always intense, but since I started trying to make my art into a real freelance business, I get wound up about invoices or client messages pretty often. Then I put them off, and it kind of builds until I’m really upset or I start missing normal things, like paying a bill.
Do you find it really hard to control or stop the worrying once it starts, especially about work-related things like invoices or client messages?

Yeah, once it starts, it’s hard for me to shut it off. I’ll think, “I need to answer that client” or “I need to deal with that invoice,” and then I get so wound up that I avoid it. Then it just sits there and gets worse until I’m really upset, like crying at the kitchen table, or I forget other normal things like paying a bill.
Do you find that your anxiety or worry is limited mostly to work-related things, like invoices or client messages, and not about other major areas of your life?

Mostly, yeah. It’s tied to trying to make my art into a real freelance business. The invoices and client messages are what really set me off, and then I avoid them until it turns into me crying at the kitchen table or forgetting regular things like paying a bill.

Has your anxiety about work-related things like invoices or client messages caused you to avoid or drop out of social or personal activities, or significantly impacted your ability to function in areas outside of work?

Yeah, it has started to spill over a bit. I don’t think I’ve totally dropped out of personal stuff, but it’s affecting more than just the work itself. Like I’ll put off replying to a client, and then while I’m trying to keep up with the art display, I’ll miss something at home, like a utility payment. So it’s not just in my head—it’s starting to mess with responsibilities outside the work too.
How long have you been feeling this way about work-related things like invoices or client messages—has it been going on for 6 months or more?
No, it hasn’t been 6 months. It’s been more like about a month, since I started trying to make my art into a more formal freelance business.
